marketDetails: Headquarters and manufacturing plant in Dos Hermanas (Seville). Distributor network especially active in Andalusia, Castilla-La Mancha, Extremadura, Madrid, Catalonia, the Canary Islands and the Balearic Islands.
One of the company's first export markets since its founding, together with Israel and Greece.
IDh's benchmark market in the Americas. Regional flagship product: RU-1802IN3, a zamak tandem carriage with cataphoresis finish, for panels up to 280 kg.
